summary: 12-tooth MOD 0.8 spur gear with a 20° pressure angle. It has a central through bore with an internal 25-tooth servo spline and a shallow recess on one face.

mountingSurfaces.description: Flat end face on the recessed side, which has a shallow counterbore around the bore
Flat end face on the opposite side, with the splined bore opening flush

notes: Outer diameter is calculated from the gear specs: MOD 0.8 with 12 teeth gives a pitch diameter of 9.6 mm and a tip diameter of 9.6 + 2×0.8 = 11.2 mm. The listed center distances confirm the module: 24 mm with the 48-tooth gear and 48 mm with the 108-tooth gear. Face width (about 8 mm) is a visual estimate from the pencil scale photo and is not stated. The bore (about 5.8 mm) is an assumed nominal size for a 25-tooth servo spline; its diameter is not given in the text. The recess on one face is visible but its diameter and depth are not stated, so it is not listed as a hole. The gear axis is along z, centered at the origin.
